final: WITH ft_joined AS (SELECT c.state_county_province, ft.transaction_amount FROM Financial_Transactions ft JOIN Accounts a ON ft.account_id = a.account_id JOIN Customers c ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id), state_sums AS (SELECT state_county_province, SUM(transaction_amount) as state_total FROM ft_joined WHERE state_county_province IS NOT NULL GROUP BY state_county_province), overall_sum AS (SELECT SUM(state_total) as total FROM state_sums WHERE state_total IS NOT NULL), with_shares AS (SELECT ss.state_total, CAST(ss.state_total AS REAL) / os.total as share FROM state_sums ss, overall_sum os WHERE os.total IS NOT NULL AND os.total > 0), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_val FROM with_shares WHERE share IS NOT NULL), filtered AS (SELECT state_total, share FROM with_shares ws, avg_share a WHERE a.avg_val IS NOT NULL AND ws.share > a.avg_val) SELECT SUM(state_total), AVG(share), AVG(share - (SELECT avg_val FROM avg_share)) FROM filtered
